title: Discarding XML/JSON Validation during DTO Assembly
pattern: Directly converting raw dynamic nested payloads (like JSON or XML trees) into domain models without performing intermediate format validation or DTD/Schema checks.
why_bad: It leaves the domain model exposed to malformed or incomplete payloads, pushing validation checks downstream into business logic where they complicate error resolution.
detection: Conversion code extracting fields from generic unstructured JSON/XML trees directly into domain objects.
fix:
Introduce strongly typed DTO structs with declarative validation rules before converting to domain types.
```rust
#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct UserDto {
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "validate_username")]
    username: String,
}
```
source: *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* by Martin Fowler (p. 392).
